title: FIDM Museum And Galleries

services.name: Past exhibitions
services.desc: The ASU FIDM Museum is only open during exhibitions and will be closed all other times. Please check exhibition dates before visiting the museum to make sure it is open. Exhibition dates and details are posted below as soon as they are announced. Experience the glamour of Hollywood’s Golden Age through the work of legendary designer Gilbert Adrian (1903-59), whose costumes shaped the iconic looks of Joan Crawford, Greta Garbo, Norma Shearer and Jean Harlow, and influenced the wardrobes of America’s most fashionable women from coast to coast. The ASU FIDM Museum is open Wednesday-Saturday, 10 a.m.-5 p.m. The museum will be closed Nov. 26-27. Experience the glamour of Hollywood’s Golden Age

blurb: Museum features a 15,000-piece collection that represents over 400 years of fashion history, including haute couture and ready-to-wear, world dress, film costumes, accessories, jewelry, textiles, fragrance packaging and ephemera.
